title: Drawdown, Losing Streaks & Survival
hook: Your risk model needs room for your strategy to be wrong.

launchpad.outcome: Read drawdown, and see how risk size changes what the same losing streak does to an account.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Can my risk model survive five losses?

options.why: Peak minus current, as a share of the peak.

slides.title: This can happen even if the strategy has an edge

options.label: Nothing, five losses is five losses
Drawdown severity, recovery burden and account fragility

slides.punch: NOT “HOW DO I NEVER LOSE FIVE TIMES?” BUT “CAN MY RISK MODEL SURVIVE FIVE LOSSES?”

slides.quote: Your risk model needs room for your strategy to be wrong. No % here is “the right one”. Size changes survival.

slides.prompt: Why does risk size matter more during a losing streak?
slides.modelAnswer: Because the same streak does very different damage depending on risk. About 4.9% at 1% per trade versus about 41% at 10%, before costs, and deeper drawdowns are harder to recover from.

takeaways: Streaks happen, even with an edge.
remember: Your risk model needs room for your strategy to be wrong.
